business_requirements: BR-001: The system must be GDPR-compliant to ensure the protection of user data
BR-002: The system must be scalable to accommodate a growing number of users
BR-003: The system must be cloud-ready to ensure high availability and reliability
BR-004: The system must support future AI recommendations and mobile integration

user_stories.action: register for an account on the website
user_stories.benefit: I can access personalized workout tracking and nutrition management features within 2 minutes of registration
acceptance_criteria: Registration form loads in under 2 seconds on a 4G connection
Registration form requires a minimum of username, email, and password
Registration form displays a clear call-to-action (CTA) button labeled 'Sign Up'
User receives a confirmation email with a link to verify their account within 1 minute of registration

user_stories.action: track my workouts on the website
user_stories.benefit: I can view my workout history and progress within 30 seconds of logging in
acceptance_criteria: Workout tracking page loads in under 2 seconds on a 4G connection
Workout tracking page displays a list of past workouts with dates and exercise details
Workout tracking page allows users to add new workouts with a minimum of exercise name, sets, reps, and weight
Workout tracking page displays a graph showing user progress over time

user_stories.action: manage my nutrition on the website
user_stories.benefit: I can view and edit my daily nutrition plan within 1 minute of logging in
acceptance_criteria: Nutrition management page loads in under 2 seconds on a 4G connection
Nutrition management page displays a list of daily meal plans with macronutrient breakdown
Nutrition management page allows users to add new meals with a minimum of meal name, calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat
Nutrition management page displays a warning if user's daily calorie intake exceeds recommended limits

user_stories.action: access the trainer portal on the website
user_stories.benefit: I can view and manage my client's workout and nutrition plans within 1 minute of logging in
acceptance_criteria: Trainer portal page loads in under 2 seconds on a 4G connection
Trainer portal page displays a list of clients with their respective workout and nutrition plans
Trainer portal page allows trainers to add new clients and assign workout and nutrition plans
Trainer portal page displays a notification if a client has not logged a workout or nutrition entry in the past 3 days

user_stories.action: make a subscription payment on the website
user_stories.benefit: I can access premium features and content within 1 minute of payment confirmation
acceptance_criteria: Payment page loads in under 2 seconds on a 4G connection
Payment page displays a clear call-to-action (CTA) button labeled 'Subscribe'
Payment page accepts a minimum of credit card and PayPal payment methods
Payment page displays a confirmation message and updates user's subscription status within 1 minute of payment confirmation

user_stories.benefit: I can stay up-to-date with my workout and nutrition plans within 1 minute of a new notification
acceptance_criteria: Notification system sends notifications to users within 1 minute of a new workout or nutrition entry
Notification system displays a maximum of 5 notifications on the website's dashboard
Notification system allows users to dismiss notifications with a single click
Notification system displays a notification if a user has not logged a workout or nutrition entry in the past 3 days

user_stories.benefit: I can view user engagement and retention metrics within 1 minute of logging in
acceptance_criteria: Analytics page loads in under 2 seconds on a 4G connection
Analytics page displays a minimum of user engagement, retention, and demographics metrics
Analytics page allows administrators to filter metrics by date range and user segment
Analytics page displays a graph showing user engagement over time

assumptions: Assumption 1: The website will be built using a responsive design to accommodate various screen sizes and devices
Assumption 2: The website will use a secure payment gateway to process subscription payments
Assumption 3: The website will use a cloud-based infrastructure to ensure high availability and scalability
out_of_scope: Item explicitly not included in this project: development of a mobile app
content.confidence_reasoning: The business requirements and user stories are well-defined, but the project timeline and budget may be challenging to meet
